sampling_object: completed 1us local counter windows; never pretend these are instantaneous queue samples
realistic_reference: port counters, common endpoint operations/topology, fixed-phase 1024ns queue histogram where that interface exists; not claimed to be available on A3
unknown_policy: queue-only does not identify cause; no credit failure is not a continuous eligibility assertion; no actual same-head evidence means credit duration unknown
review_policy: freeze before inspecting new smaller-scale labels; historical scales are related records, not independent generalization
